[[File:Qyzen_with_staff.png|thumb|right|200px|The Trandoshan hunter Qyzen Fess was a trapper.]]
A '''trapper''' was a type of [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]]. The majority of the [[Lasat/Legends|Lasat]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lasan/Legends|Lasan]],<ref name="AlienEncounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> as well as the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunter [[Qyzen Fess]], were trappers.<ref name="Qyzen">{{HolonetOld|biographies|qyzen-fess|Qyzen Fess}}</ref>
